 loop

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_INTERIM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE update_interim IS
 CURSOR utrs_cur is
 select utrs.test_id, utrs.test_seq_no
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id
 and coll_date = :qc_units.coll_date
 and qc_test_date IS NULL
 and ( (test_series_id is not null and test_series_id = :qc_units.test_series_id)
 OR 
 (test_series_id is null and test_id = :qc_units.test_id)
 ) 
 and result_status_1 is null
 and cancel_flag is null;
 nCnt NUMBER; 
BEGIN
 FOR utrs_rec IN utrs_cur 
 LOOP
 -- check in interim by test id and test seq no.
 select COUNT(1) into nCnt
 from rgt_interim_results
 where unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id
 and coll_date = :qc_units.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id
 and test_id = utrs_rec.test_id
 and test_seq_no = utrs_rec.test_seq_no;
 
 -- if records found, update qc flag and qc columns
 if nCnt > 0 then
 :qc_flag := 'T';
 
 update rgt_interim_results
 set results_qc_date = SYSDATE,
 results_qc_user = :banner.user_id
 where unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id
 and coll_date = :qc_units.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id 
 and test_id = utrs_rec.test_id
 and test_seq_no = utrs_rec.test_seq_no;
 else
 -- records not in interim but utrs has null result. Check contract results method;
 
 if contract_results_method = 'F' then -- default is F
 show_error('1027');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 
 
 select count(1) into nCnt
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id
 and coll_date = :qc_units.coll_date
 and chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id
 and cancel_flag is null
 and test_id = utrs_rec.test_id
 and ( (test_series_id is not null and test_series_id = :qc_units.test_series_id)
 OR 
 (test_series_id is null and test_id = :qc_units.test_id)
 ) 
 and result_status_1 is not null;
 
 if nCnt = 0 then
 show_error('1027');
 check_package_failure; 
 elsif nCnt = 1 then
 NULL;
 else
 :qc_flag := 'T';
 end if; 
 end if; 
 
 
 END LOOP;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_SKIP_SAMPLES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE insert_skip_samples 
IS
 nCOUNT NUMBER:=0;
 nSkipMan NUMBER:=0;
 nSkipAuto NUMBER:=0;
 szUserID VARCHAR2(30);

 PROCEDURE insert_sqc 
 IS
 nExist NUMBER:=0;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(1)
 INTO nExist 
 FROM rgt_confirm_skip_samples 
 WHERE unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id AND
 chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id AND 
 reason_code = 'SQC' AND 
 skip_flag = 'S'
 ;

 IF nExist = 0 
 THEN
 INSERT INTO rgt_confirm_skip_samples
 (
 CHAPTER_ID
 ,UNIT_ID 
 ,COLL_DATE 
 ,SKIP_FLAG 
 ,INSERT_DATE 
 ,INSERT_USER_ID
 ,REASON_CODE 
 ,RESET_DATE 
 )
 VALUES
 (
 :qc_units.chapter_id 
 ,:qc_units.unit_id
 ,:qc_units.coll_date
 ,'S'
 ,SYSDATE
 ,:banner.user_id
 ,'SQC'
 ,NULL
 )
 ;
 END IF;

 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 MESSAGE('Error-Insert Skip-Samples');
 PAUSE;
 handle_error;
 END insert_sqc;

BEGIN

 --Check IF the unit is in the skip table by manual process;

 SELECT COUNT(1) INTO nSkipMan 
 FROM rgt_confirm_skip_samples 
 WHERE unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id AND
 chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id AND 
 reason_code NOT IN ('SQC','RQC')
 ;

 IF nSkipMan > 0 
 THEN 
 DELETE rgt_confirm_skip_samples 
 WHERE unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id AND 
 chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id AND 
 reset_date IS NOT NULL
 ;
 
 IF SQL%FOUND 
 THEN 
 INSERT_SQC;
 END IF;

 ELSE
 -- Chek IF the unit is presnt with the automatic skip before
 SELECT NVL(COUNT(*),0) 
 INTO nSkipAuto 
 FROM rgt_confirm_skip_samples 
 WHERE unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id AND
 chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id AND
 reason_code IN ('SQC','RQC')
 ;

 IF nSkipAuto > 0 
 THEN 
 UPDATE rgt_confirm_skip_samples 
 SET reset_date = NULL
 ,skip_flag = 'S' 
 WHERE unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id AND 
 chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id AND 
 reason_code IN ('SQC','RQC')
 ; 
 ELSE 
 INSERT_SQC; 
 END IF; 
 END IF;
EXCEPTION 
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 MESSAGE('Insert Skip Samples');
 PAUSE;
 handle_error;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_SKIP_SAMPLES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPDATE_SKIP_SAMPLES IS
 nCount NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 select nvl(count(*), 0)
 into nCount
 from rgt_confirm_skip_samples
 where unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id 
 and reason_code = 'SQC'
 and skip_flag = 'S';

 If nCount > 0 then
 UPDATE rgt_confirm_skip_samples
 set reset_date = sysdate, skip_flag = 'R'
 where unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id 
 and reason_code = 'SQC';
 End if;

END;

-- Added by Kishore on 08/13/2015. SCR 21546
PROCEDURE REPORT_GENERATE(pl_rep_name in varchar2, pl_parm_id in varchar2) IS
 parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir varchar2(30);
 temp varchar2(40);
 a_port varchar2(40);
 --val varchar2(2000);
 repid REPORT_OBJECT;
 v_rep VARCHAR2(100);
 rep_status VARCHAR2(20);
 
 --for Apps server 
 report_id Report_Object;
 ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
 vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
 vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);
 v_local_time date;
 v_sysdate date;

 -- Multiple reports server changes;
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(100);
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200);
 l_svr_url VARCHAR2(100) := NULL;
BEGIN 
 -- time zone change --5/11/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, to_date(to_char(sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'), 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'), v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'), 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'), 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 end if;
 
 BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list ' || pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 END; 
 
 --message('number -1');
 
 /* Get the report server name from the master code table*/
 /* -- Commented on 04/12/2012; Ashok; Below code moved to LT_RepServer_Lab.pkg
 BEGIN
 Select code_desc into val 
 from master_codes 
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code='RPSVR'
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,v_sysdate+1); 
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 message('Report server is not defined in the SYSPARM table for REPSVR');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 End; 
 */
 
 -- Added on 04/10/2012 to get least active jobs report server name.
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server( out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );

 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 -- Change to print the report from the form
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_url (l_svr_name, l_svr_url, l_err_msg);
 
 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_url IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server URL');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 -- End of change
 
 ------------
 --message('number -2');

 --val:='rep_chdevsrv10_oracleas1'; 
 --filename:=:rpt_parm.report_name||'_'||'_'||user;
 
 filename := pl_rep_name || '_' || pl_parm_id || '_' || LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid || '.pdf';
 report_id := find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
 
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id, REPORT_FILENAME, lower(pl_rep_name)); --'vdrinter.rdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id, REPORT_COMM_MODE, ASYNCHRONOUS);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id, REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE, BATCH);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id, REPORT_DESTYPE, file);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id, REPORT_DESNAME, filename);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id, REPORT_DESFORMAT, 'pdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id, REPORT_SERVER, l_svr_name);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id, REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

 add_parameter(pl_id, 'P_PARM_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_parm_id) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id, 'NO_OF_COPIES', TEXT_PARAMETER, '1');
 add_parameter(pl_id, 'P_CHAPTER_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id);
 add_parameter(pl_id, 'PRINT_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, NULL);
 add_parameter(pl_id, 'HEADER_YN', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'N');
 --add_parameter(pl_id, 'DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG', TEXT_PARAMETER, :rpt_parm.delete_after_print_flag);
 --add_parameter(pl_id, 'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG', TEXT_PARAMETER, :rpt_parm.auto_print_flag);
 add_parameter(pl_id, 'RPT_NAME', TEXT_PARAMETER, upper(pl_rep_name));
 add_parameter(pl_id, 'P_USER', TEXT_PARAMETER, upper(:banner.user_id)) ;
 
 ReportServerJob := run_report_object(report_id, pl_id);
 vjob_id := substr(reportserverjob, length(l_svr_name) + 2);
 vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);
 --message('Status='||vc_rep_status);

 --message('Report Submitted ... ');
 
 -- Uncommented by Kishore on 08/18/2015. SCR 21546. Change to display report from form.
 /* Commented on 04/12/2012; Ashok -- Only submit the report; Cronjob will update the status of the report */
 WHILE vc_rep_status in ('RUNNING', 'OPENING_REPORT', 'ENQUEUED', null) LOOP
 vc_rep_status := REPORT_OBJECT_STATUS(ReportServerJob);

 --message('number -3');

 IF vc_rep_status='FINISHED' THEN
 /*
 update rpt_parm set report_status = 'C'
 where user_name = decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid, 1, 3),

 LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)

 --WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT('/reports/rwservlet/getjobid'|| vjob_id ||'?server='||val,'_blank');

 -- Uncommented by Kishore on 08/18/2015. SCR 21546. Change to open report from form
 WEB.SHOW_DOCUMENT(l_svr_url || '/reports/rwservlet/getjobid' || vjob_id || 
 '?server=' || l_svr_name, '_blank');

 update rpt_parm 
 set rep_job_id = vjob_id,
 rep_server = l_svr_name
 where upper(report_name) = upper(pl_rep_name) 
 and user_name = decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid, 1, 3), 'OPS', substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid, 5), LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid)
 and parm_id = pl_parm_id;

-- Added by Kishore on 08/13/2015. SCR 21546
PROCEDURE gen_report (id in varchar2) IS
 temp_count NUMBER;
 temp_printer VARCHAR2(10);
 usr_id varchar2(15) := name_in('banner.user_id'); 
 s_print_id varchar2(80);
 temp_mode varchar2(20);
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT count(*)
 INTO temp_count
 FROM rpt_parm
 WHERE appl_id = 'DON'
 AND user_name = usr_id 
 AND report_name = 'GERSAMPQ' 
 AND parm_id = id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 
 IF temp_count = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 INSERT into rpt_parm
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_date, submit_date, report_status)
 VALUES
 ('DON', usr_id, 'GERSAMPQ', id,
 sysdate, sysdate, 'E');
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM rpt_parm_select
 WHERE appl_id = 'DON' 
 AND user_name = usr_id 
 AND report_name = 'GERSAMPQ'
 AND parm_id = id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 END IF;
 
 BEGIN
 INSERT into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id, user_name, report_name, parm_id,
 parm_no, parm_select, parm_code)
 VALUES
 ('DON', usr_id, 'GERSAMPQ', id, 
 1, id, 'UNIT');
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_QC_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE query_qc_units IS
 --units_qc_tab CNFRESQC.units_aat;
 units_cnt_rec CNFRESQC.units_cnt_rt;
 lv_status VARCHAR2(2000);
 nCnt NUMBER;
 
 lv_lock_level VARCHAR2(1);
 lv_lock_value VARCHAR2(15);
 lv_lock_status VARCHAR2(500);
BEGIN
 
 GLOBALVAR.session_id := TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMMDDHH24MISSSS'); -- TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'YYMMDDHH24MISSxFF');
 
 -- lock logic;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.include_all = 'Y' then
 lv_lock_level := 'A';
 lv_lock_value := 'ALL';
 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.test_series_id is not null then
 lv_lock_level := 'S';
 lv_lock_value := :ctrl_blk_1.test_series_id;
 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.test_id is not null then
 lv_lock_level := 'T';
 lv_lock_value := :ctrl_blk_1.test_id;
 end if;
 
 select COUNT(1) into nCnt
 from cnf_qc_lock
 where lock_level = 'A';
 
 if nCnt > 0 then
 show_error('1422'); -- another qc session in progress. please try again (error)
 RAISE GLOBALVAR.clear_screen;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 select COUNT(1) into nCnt
 from cnf_qc_lock
 where lock_level = lv_lock_level
 and lock_value = lv_lock_value;
 
 if nCnt > 0 then
 show_error('1422'); -- another qc session in progress. please try again (error)
 RAISE GLOBALVAR.clear_screen;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if :ctrl_blk_1.include_all = 'Y' then
 select COUNT(1) into nCnt
 from cnf_qc_lock;
 
 if nCnt > 0 then
 show_error('1422'); -- another qc session in progress. please try again (error)
 RAISE GLOBALVAR.clear_screen;
 check_package_failure; 
 end if; 
 end if;
 
 
 lab_common.confirmatory_qc_lock(p_session_id => globalvar.session_id,
 p_lock_level => lv_lock_level,
 p_lock_value => lv_lock_value,
 p_lock_user => :BANNER.USER_ID,
 p_lock_flag_LU => 'L',
 p_status => lv_lock_status
 );

 IF lv_lock_status <> 'OK' then
 message('confirmatory qc lock error ' || lv_lock_status);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 ---------------------
 
 -- Call the procedure
 cnfresqc.compute_qc(p_session_id => GLOBALVAR.session_id, 
 p_chapter_id => NULL, -- :global.chapter_id, -- MLT 858
 p_series_id => :CTRL_BLK_1.TEST_SERIES_ID,
 p_test_id => :CTRL_BLK_1.TEST_ID,
 p_qc_totals => units_cnt_rec,
 p_status => lv_status);
 
 /*
 CNFRESQC.compute_qc_test_flag( p_test_series_id => :CTRL_BLK_1.TEST_SERIES_ID,
 p_test_id => :CTRL_BLK_1.TEST_ID,
 p_chapter_id => NULL, -- :global.chapter_id, -- MLT 858
 p_units_qc => units_qc_tab, 
 p_units_cnt => units_cnt_rec,
 p_status => lv_status
 );
 
 */
 
 if nvl(lv_status,'OK') <> 'OK' then
 message('Error in compute qc flag ' || lv_status);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 
 
 select count(1) into nCnt
 from cnf_qc_units
 where session_id = GLOBALVAR.session_id;
 
 if nCnt = 0 then
 show_error('1420');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 
 /* 
 if units_qc_tab.COUNT = 0 then
 show_error('1420');
 check_package_failure;
 end if; 
 */
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_count := units_cnt_rec.total_units;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_skipped_units := units_cnt_rec.skipped_units;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_count_no_trns := units_cnt_rec.incomp_res_units;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_sqc_reason := units_cnt_rec.SQC_units;
 
 GO_BLOCK('qc_units');
 
 :system.message_level := '10';
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 
 /*
 FOR rec in (SELECT unit_id, chapter_id, coll_date, qc_reason, test_series_id, test_id
 FROM cnf_qc_units
 WHERE session_id = GLOBALVAR.session_id
 order by coll_date, unit_id)
 LOOP
 if cntr = 1 then
 cntr := 0;
 first_record;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 :qc_units.unit_id := rec.unit_id;
 :qc_units.coll_date := rec.coll_date;
 :qc_units.chapter_id := rec.chapter_id;
 :qc_units.qc_reason := rec.qc_reason;
 :qc_units.s_chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:qc_units.unit_id,null,null); 
 :qc_units.test_series_id := rec.test_series_id;
 :qc_units.test_id := rec.test_id;
 END LOOP;
 */
 /*
 For i in 1 .. units_qc_tab.COUNT LOOP
 if i = 1 then
 first_record;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 
 :qc_units.unit_id := units_qc_tab(i).unit_id;
 :qc_units.s_chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:qc_units.unit_id,null,null); 
 :qc_units.coll_date := units_qc_tab(i).coll_date;
 :qc_units.qc_reason := units_qc_tab(i).qc_reason;
 :qc_units.chapter_id := units_qc_tab(i).chapter_id;
 END LOOP;
 */
 EXCEPTION
 when GLOBALVAR.clear_screen then
 raise;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
END;

FUNCTION contract_results_method RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 CURSOR contract_cur IS
 SELECT c.results_method
 FROM units u, contracts c
 WHERE u.contract_id = c.contract_id
 AND u.unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id
 and u.chapter_id= :qc_units.chapter_id
 and u.coll_date = :qc_units.coll_date;
 lv_results_method VARCHAR2(1) := 'F';
BEGIN

 OPEN contract_cur;
 FETCH contract_cur into lv_results_method;
 CLOSE contract_cur;
 
 RETURN lv_results_method;
END;

BEGIN
 update utrs
 set qc_test_flag = :qc_units.qc_flag,
 qc_test_date = :qc_units.qc_test_date,
 qc_test_user = :banner.user_id
 where unit_id = :qc_units.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :qc_units.chapter_id
 and coll_date = :qc_units.coll_date
 and ( (test_series_id is not null and test_series_id = :qc_units.test_series_id)
 OR 
 (test_series_id is null and test_id = :qc_units.test_id)
 ) 
 and cancel_flag is null; 
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_TS_ID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct ut.test_series_id ts_id, mc.code_desc
 from utrs ut, master_codes mc
 where ut.qc_test_date IS NULL
 and ut.test_series_id is not null 
 and ut.test_series_id = mc.code
 and mc.code_type = 'TRGID'
 and ut.cancel_flag is null
 and ut.result_status_1 is not null 
 and (ut.unit_id, ut.coll_date, ut.chapter_id) not in
 (select unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id
 from RGT_CONFIRM_SKIP_SAMPLES
 where reset_date is null
 and reason_code != 'SQC')
 and exists (
 select 1
 from units u
 where u.unit_id = ut.unit_id
 and u.cnf_checkin_flag IN ('Y','S')
 )
 and :ctrl_blk_1.chp_sysdate between mc.eff_date and nvl(mc.term_date, sysdate+ 30) 
order by test_series_id

RecordGroup.Name: RG_TEST_ID
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct ut.test_id ts_id, vt.test_desc
 from utrs ut, valid_tests vt
 where ut.test_id = vt.test_id
 and vt.test_group in
 ( SELECT mc.code
 FROM master_codes mc
 WHERE mc.code_type = 'TSTGP'
 AND :ctrl_blk_1.chp_sysdate between mc.eff_date and nvl(mc.term_date, :ctrl_blk_1.chp_sysdate+1)
 ) 
 and ut.qc_test_date IS NULL
 and ut.test_series_id is null 
 and ut.cancel_flag is null 
 and ut.result_status_1 is not null 
 and sysdate between vt.eff_date and nvl(vt.term_date, sysdate + 1)
 and (ut.unit_id, ut.coll_date, ut.chapter_id) not in
 (select unit_id, coll_date, chapter_id
 from RGT_CONFIRM_SKIP_SAMPLES
 where reset_date is null
 and reason_code != 'SQC')
 and exists (
 select 1
 from units u
 where u.unit_id = ut.unit_id
 and u.cnf_checkin_flag IN ('Y','S')
 )
order by ut.test_id
